details:
- CVE-2022-0585: fix large/infinite loops in multiple dissectors (AMP, ATN-ULCS, BP, GDSDB, P_MUL, WAP, ZigBee ZCL, OpenFlow v5/v6, IPDC, TDS, ASN.1 PER, FT_UINT_BYTES/STRING)
- CVE-2022-4344: fix Kafka dissector memory exhaustion via decompression/loop bounds
- CVE-2023-0666: fix RTPS dissector heap-based buffer overflow in g_strlcpy dest_size
- CVE-2023-0668: fix synphasor dissector heap-based out-of-bounds read via val_to_str_const
- CVE-2023-2855: fix candump file parser stack buffer overflow on too-long frame length
- CVE-2023-2856: fix VMS TCPIPtrace file parser stack overflow in packet length search
- CVE-2023-2858: fix NetScaler nstrace v10 file parser heap buffer overflow
- CVE-2023-2952: fix XRA dissector infinite loop via integer overflow
